purpose: Source-only M11 location-calibration design; no target data or experiment result estimates used
admission_status: Extraction packet for controller admission; this file is not a registry approval

sources.population: SHIP-Trend baseline 2008-2012; n=4402 after excluding pregnancy and missing HbA1c from n=4420; whole population includes self-reported diabetes; northeastern Germany
sources.measurement: Bio-Rad Diamat high-performance liquid chromatography; HbA1c percent; fasting blood samples in SHIP-Trend
sources.overlap: Same SHIP-Trend baseline cohort as volzke2015 and grossmann2024; not independent replication

pooled_covariates.statistical_definition: Raw descriptive medians (25th;75th percentile), not means or confidence intervals; quantile interpolation convention unspecified
pooled_covariates.uncertainty: No sampling uncertainty reported for these descriptive quantiles

hba1c_pct_by_sex.statistical_definition: Unadjusted sex-specific marginal quantiles in the whole analyzed cohort, not conditional intercepts or healthy-reference limits
hba1c_pct_by_sex.uncertainty: No sampling uncertainty or quantile interpolation convention reported

age_slope.locator: Table 2 (XML Tab2), whole SHIP-Trend population, men/women, age per 10 years; Methods Statistical analysis (Par19)
age_slope.statistical_definition: Sex-specific multivariable linear-regression conditional-mean coefficients; no spline term in these two whole SHIP-Trend strata
age_slope.derivation: Divide estimate and standard error by ten; not a quantile-regression slope

unknown: Numeric age spline knots for other strata
sources.source_support_caution: Paper describes sampling adults age 20-79; this is not proof that age at examination has a maximum of 79. Other baseline reports include ages above 79.

sources.retrieval: Primary PMC HTML retrieved directly with Invoke-WebRequest; web search also located publisher/PMC. Europe PMC fullTextXML request failed HTTP500; web open PMC returned a browser challenge.
sources.population: Original whole SHIP-Trend baseline n=4420 (2145 men,2275 women), not exactly the Masuch n=4402 analysis subset
sources.overlap: Same baseline cohort; shared participants with masuch2019 and grossmann2024

age_by_sex.locator: Table 1, HTML section T1, SHIP-Trend Number row
age_by_sex.statistical_definition: Absolute participant counts and unweighted within-sex proportions; >=70 is an open-ended final bin
age_by_sex.uncertainty: These are baseline cohort counts, not estimated sampling uncertainty
age_by_sex.audit: Counts sum to reported totals. No within-bin ages recoverable.

weighted_bmi_for_sensitivity_only.locator: Table 2, HTML section T2, BMI row and footnote; Methods Statistical analysis
weighted_bmi_for_sensitivity_only.statistical_definition: Weighted medians with 95% confidence intervals, not IQRs; SHIP-Trend uses poststratification weights multiplied by inverse participation-probability weights
weighted_bmi_for_sensitivity_only.reason: Weighted population estimands do not equal the unweighted Masuch sample distribution; narrow printed intervals cannot be used as individual BMI spread

sources.retrieval: Primary PMC HTML successfully retrieved directly and Table1 inspected; independent subagent also located indexed primary PDF content
sources.admission: Not needed for the proposed primary pair; context cross-check only unless separately admitted by controller
sources.locator: Table 1, HTML section ijms-25-01485-t001, whole SHIP-TREND column (not the n203 analyzed subset)
sources.population: Whole SHIP-Trend baseline n4420; same cohort as preceding two publications
sources.statistical_definition: Means and standard deviations, not medians or standard errors; pooled across sex

bounded_search_conclusion: Actual source covariate summaries permit an assumption-labelled source-location calibration. They do not uniquely identify a sex-specific conditional location or the source joint covariate/residual law. No raw whole-cohort age-BMI correlation was found; independence remains an assumption.
